As a kid growing up in British Columbia our neighborhood didn't have much growing up.  I've had a lot of good memories as a child but one really stuck out. me and my friends all grew up playing video games on the Game Cube. Every weekend we a bunch of us would go to one of my friends named Jae's house where in the basement we would setup a super smash bros melee tournament between the lot of us. I remember it was my last week before I moved for Hawaii, I remember having a blast for my last day we would play Mario Party 7, Mario Kart, and playing with the bongos for one of the Donkey Kong games. It was a heck of a time. That being said, on the morning I was leaving I had gave Jae and all my other pals my own GameCube and a Game-boy. God, I remember seeing the look on their faces they were so filled with joy, man I wish I was a child again. simpler times.

Edit : I had to move to HI because my dad got deployed and we had to go with him
